01 / SIYANO

Essential functions, all in one place.

Equipment & history

Organise equipment, sites and locations. Find technical records, documents and maintenance history for each asset.

Requests & work orders

Review requests, create work orders, assign technicians and track checklists, time and parts.

Preventive maintenance

Schedule calendar-based or meter-based maintenance with reusable procedures and due-date tracking.

Planning & teams

Organise assignments and identify overlapping schedules and absences before work begins.

Inventory & procurement

Track parts, stores, reservations, transfers, purchase requests and partial receipts.

Costs & reports

Bring together labour, parts and services. Access history, PDF reports and CSV or Excel exports.

Cloud or a server at your company.

The same software can run on cloud hosting or a customer server. Users connect through a browser; a connection to the server is required to save operations.
